written_by: Claude Code, drafted from Diablo Valley College's 2026-2027 catalog for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Diablo Valley College's own courses for the Plan (spec 24 → Data, college_courses). Code, title, units and C-ID are copied from the course pages of DVC's 2026-2027 catalog, the newest one DVC links to from dvc.edu (https://www.dvc.edu/academics/class-schedule-catalog → https://dvc.elumenapp.com/catalog/DVC2026-2027Catalog/). The catalog is an eLumen app; its pages load from eLumen's public publish endpoint, which answered plain requests, so nothing was blocked. Each source_url is the course's own page, https://dvc.elumenapp.com/catalog/DVC2026-2027Catalog/course/<subject><number>. c_id is the C-ID the course page prints under "Comparable course"; null where it prints none. Where it prints a stand-alone C-ID and a sequence one, c_id is the stand-alone one a pathway requirement for that course's topics names (BIOL 130 → BIOL 190, CHEM 120 → CHEM 110, PHYS 130 → PHYS 205, PHYS 230 → PHYS 210). BIOL 131, CHEM 121 and CHEM 227 have c_id null: they print only a sequence C-ID (BIOL 135S, CHEM 120S, CHEM 160S) that needs the other course. CHEM 226 and COMSC 110 have c_id null too: CHEM 226 prints CHEM 150 and CHEM 160S (with CHEM 227), COMSC 110 prints COMP 112 and ITIS 130, and no pathway requirement for their topics names any of these, like LPC's CHEM 12A and CS 7. COMM 163 is 3 units: the course page prints 1.5-4.0, and DVC's Communication Studies AA-T 2.0 says at most 3 units of it count (todo to confirm). Topics come from the C-ID number, the course title against the topic, or, for the TMC lists (comm-list-*, econ-list-*, polisci-*, psych-list-*, sociology-list-*, business-math, econ-calculus, math-list-a, diff-eq-and-linear-algebra), the list in DVC's own AA-T or AS-T page for that major in the same catalog (https://dvc.elumenapp.com/catalog/DVC2026-2027Catalog/program/<degree>). A course in an ADT list also gets the later list topics that say "any List A course not already used". DVC's Political Science AA-T isn't labeled List A and List B: its 9-unit block (statistics, POLS 120, 210, 220, 240, 250) is read as List A and its 6-unit block (ANTHR 130, ECON C2001, ECON C2002, HIST 140, HIST 141, POLS 127, POLS 151, SOCSC 101) as List B. DVC's Sociology AA-T is read the same way: the 6-unit block after the stats/social problems/research block (PSYC 225, SOCIO 122, 124, 125, 135) is List A, the last 3-unit block (SOCIO 131, SOCSC 120) is List B. POLS 122, POLS 123 and POLS 210 print C-ID POLS 110 or POLS 120, so they get the core topics. BIOL 130 is biology-first because BIOL 131 lists BIOL 130 as an advisory. COMSC 110 prints C-ID COMP 112, not COMP 122, so it isn't cs1; COMSC 165 prints COMP 122 and is cs1. PHYS 231 (the third physics course) and MATH 183 (second business calculus) are left out: no topic plainly fits them. PHILO 170 Symbolic Logic is comm-logic-computing-culture and ENGL 124 (An Introduction to Linguistics) is comm-three-more, both from the title. comm-intro and science-extra have no DVC course here: the catalog doesn't make a match plain, so students type their own course for those. SOCIO 120 Introduction to Sociology is from the 2025-2026 catalog (academic_year 2025-26): it isn't on the 2026-2027 sociology course list and its 2026-2027 page is empty, though 2026-2027 AA-Ts still list it (todo). BUS 250 and MATH 195 have todos: topic from the title only, no C-ID, and DVC's own ADT doesn't use them there. A second person checks each row against the catalog. Then run: npm run import -- data/raw/planning/college-courses-diablo-valley.json --dry-run
